rows.title: Multiplication and Division Word Problems
rows.instruction: Read each story. Use the picture to help you. Write the answer in the box, then finish the answer sentence.
rows.skill: Solve multiplication and division word problems by modelling groups vs group size (share vs make groups)

rows.title: Multiplication Word Problems
rows.instruction: The picture shows the equal groups. Write each answer in the box.
rows.skill: Solve multiplication and division word problems by modelling groups vs group size (share vs make groups)

rows.title: Division Word Problems: Sharing
rows.instruction: Each story shares things out. Deal them into the boxes.
rows.skill: Solve multiplication and division word problems by modelling groups vs group size (share vs make groups)

rows.title: Division Word Problems: Making Groups
rows.instruction: Ring the equal groups in the picture, then write the answer.

rows.title: Division with Remainders: Ring the Groups
rows.instruction: Ring groups of the second number in each pile. Write how many groups you made and how many pictures are left over.
rows.skill: Divide with a remainder; the remainder is always smaller than the divisor

rows.title: 4 by 4 Logic Grid Puzzles: Six Clues
rows.instruction: Four children and four pictures. Use every clue: cross out what cannot be true and check what must be true until each row has one answer.
rows.skill: Solve a logic grid from clues (cross out what cannot be, tick what must be)

rows.title: Two-Attribute Logic Puzzles: Two Pictures per Child
rows.instruction: Each child has one picture from each set. Use the linking clues to fill all three grids.
rows.skill: Solve a logic grid from clues (cross out what cannot be, tick what must be)

rows.title: Share It Out: What Is Left Over?
rows.instruction: Deal the pile into the boxes one at a time. Write how many each box gets and how many cannot be shared.
rows.skill: Divide with a remainder; the remainder is always smaller than the divisor

rows.title: Division with Remainders: Practice Rows
rows.instruction: Every division leaves something over. Write the answer and the remainder in each row.
rows.skill: Divide with a remainder; the remainder is always smaller than the divisor

rows.title: Exact or Not? Divisions With and Without a Remainder
rows.instruction: Decide whether each division comes out exactly. Circle your choice and write the remainder, 0 if there is none.
rows.skill: Divide with a remainder; the remainder is always smaller than the divisor

rows.title: Find the Error: The Remainder Is Too Big
rows.instruction: Every division has been worked out wrongly. Cross out the wrong numbers and write the right answer and remainder in the boxes.
rows.skill: Divide with a remainder; the remainder is always smaller than the divisor

rows.title: Hop Back on the Number Line: What Is Left?
rows.instruction: Start at the marked number and draw hops back of the same size until a whole hop no longer fits. Write the hops and where you land.
rows.skill: Divide with a remainder; the remainder is always smaller than the divisor

rows.title: The Water Cycle: Label the Diagram
rows.instruction: Read the four words in the bank and write each one on the line that has the same number as on the diagram.
rows.skill: Name the stages of the water cycle: evaporation, condensation, precipitation, collection

rows.title: Odd or Even Sum? Decide Without Adding
rows.instruction: Do not add. Look at the underlined ones digit of each number, use the table, and tick whether the sum is even or odd.
rows.skill: Predict whether a sum is odd or even from the addends' parity, without adding

rows.title: Rounding Up or Down? Sort the Numbers
rows.instruction: Does each number round up or down to the nearest ten? Write it in the right bin.
rows.skill: Round to the nearest 10 and 100 (number line, halfway, up/down)

rows.title: Rounding to the Nearest 100
rows.instruction: Round each number to the nearest hundred and write it in the box. Look at the tens digit.
rows.skill: Round to the nearest 10 and 100 (number line, halfway, up/down)

rows.title: Round, then Estimate the Sum
rows.instruction: Round both numbers to the nearest ten and write them in the boxes. Then add the rounded numbers.
rows.skill: Round both addends, add the rounded numbers, and judge whether an exact answer is reasonable

rows.title: Which Numbers Round to 50?
rows.instruction: Circle every number that rounds to the ten shown at the top. Look at the ones digit of each number.
rows.skill: Round to the nearest 10 and 100 (number line, halfway, up/down)

rows.title: Rounding to the Nearest 10 and 100
rows.instruction: Round each number twice: to the nearest ten in the first box and to the nearest hundred in the second.
rows.skill: Round to the nearest 10 and 100 (number line, halfway, up/down)

rows.title: Parts of a Flower
rows.instruction: Write the name of each numbered part of the flower on its line. Cross out the word in the bank that is not a part of a flower.
rows.skill: Name the parts of a flower and what each does

rows.title: Butterfly and Frog Life Cycles Compared
rows.instruction: Read each sentence and put a check under the butterfly, the frog or both when it is true for that animal.
rows.skill: Compare the butterfly and frog life cycles (true of one, the other, or both)

rows.title: Planets in Order from the Sun
rows.instruction: Write the name of each planet on its line, starting next to the Sun. Use every name in the bank once.
rows.skill: Order the planets from the Sun and sort them into rocky and giant planets

rows.title: Giant and Rocky Planets
rows.instruction: Sort the names. Write each one in the right box: giant planet, small rocky planet or not a planet.
rows.skill: Order the planets from the Sun and sort them into rocky and giant planets

rows.title: Continents and Oceans
rows.instruction: Find each continent and ocean on the map. Write its number in the box next to its name.
rows.skill: Locate the seven continents and five oceans on a world map

rows.title: Word Fields: Words for Go and Look
rows.instruction: Write each word in the field it belongs to.
rows.skill: Group verbs into word fields by meaning and tell close words apart (stroll/dash, glance/stare)

rows.title: Who Does It? The Person Word
rows.instruction: Look at each person, read the word beside them and write the person word in the empty brick.
rows.skill: Form person words with a suffix (bake -> baker, run -> runner) and know what they mean

rows.title: Root Words in Sentences
rows.instruction: Write the four words above each stone into the sentences below it, one word in each gap.
rows.skill: Use a known root to choose the right family form for a sentence (bake / baker / baking / baked)

rows.title: Sink or Float Investigation: My Lab Report
rows.instruction: Choose a question, write what you think, test it, then draw what happened and write what you learned.
rows.skill: Run a fair test: predict, test, record what happened and draw a conclusion (sink or float)

rows.title: Cursive Sentences to Copy
rows.instruction: Trace the grey sentence, then copy each printed sentence in cursive on the two lines below it.
rows.skill: Trace and copy a sentence in joined (cursive) handwriting
